electricityContract.terms: Quarterly billing unless monthly billing is applied for eligible customers. Further information regarding billing frequency is available at https://www.energyaustralia.com.au/business/help-and-support/faqs/accounts-bills-and-payments. electricityContract.variation: The rates for Standing Offer Business may vary, either when the AER changes the reference price, or when we review our rates each year. We will notify you before any rate change occurs.

demandCharges.description: Demand charges are applied to the maximum half hourly kW power reading (maximum quarter hourly for 15 minute meters) within the billing period. The chargeable kW reading occurs between 7am to 5pm on weekdays. The demand charge is in cents per KW per day and is calculated on the number of days in the billing period.
